//========================= // CHUNK //========================= class WorldChunk{ constructor( cx, cy ){ this.cx=cx; this.cy=cy; this.tiles=[]; this.objects=[]; this.loaded=false; } } //========================= // NOISE //========================= function worldNoise( x, y, seed ){ const n= Math.sin( x*127.1+ y*311.7+ seed )* 43758.5453; //================================================ // QUEST LOOKUP //================================================ function getStoryQuest( id ){ for( const chapter of StorySystem.chapters ){ const quest= chapter.quests.find( q=> q.id===id ); if(quest) return quest; } return null; } //================================================ // CHAPTER LOOKUP //================================================ function getStoryChapter( id ){ return StorySystem .chapters .find( chapter=> chapter.id===id ); } //================================================ // START QUEST //================================================ function startStoryQuest( id ){ const quest= getStoryQuest(id); if(!quest) return false; const chapter= StorySystem.chapters.find( c=> c.quests.includes( quest ) ); if( !chapter|| !chapter.unlocked ) return false; if( !checkStoryRequirements( quest ) ) return false; quest.started=true; StorySystem.currentQuest= quest.id; StorySystem.dialogueIndex=0; StorySystem.dialogueOpen=true; return true; } //================================================ // REQUIREMENTS //================================================ function checkStoryRequirements( quest ){ for( const flag of quest.requiredFlags ){ if( !StorySystem.flags[flag] ) return false; } return true; } //================================================ // OBJECTIVE PROGRESS //================================================ function updateStoryObjective( type, target, amount=1 ){ for( const chapter of StorySystem.chapters ){ for( const quest of chapter.quests ){ if( !quest.started|| quest.completed ) continue; for( const objective of quest.objectives ){ if( objective.type!==type|| objective.target!==target ) continue; objective.progress+=amount; if( objective.progress>= objective.amount ){ objective.progress= objective.amount; objective.completed=true; } } checkStoryQuestComplete( quest ); } } } //================================================ // CHECK QUEST //================================================ function checkStoryQuestComplete( quest ){ if( quest.objectives.length===0 ) return false; const complete= quest.objectives.every( objective=> objective.completed ); if(complete){ quest.completed=true; StorySystem .completedQuests .add( quest.id ); completeStoryQuest( quest ); return true; } return false; } //================================================ // COMPLETE QUEST //================================================ function completeStoryQuest( quest ){ if( StorySystem .rewardsClaimed .has( quest.id ) ) return; StorySystem .rewardsClaimed .add( quest.id ); const reward= quest.rewards; if( typeof Player!=="undefined" ){ if( reward.exp ){ if( typeof gainExp=== "function" ){ gainExp( reward.exp ); } else{ Player.exp= ( Player.exp|| 0 )+ reward.exp; } } if( reward.gold ){ Player.gold= ( Player.gold|| 0 )+ reward.gold; } } for( const item of reward.items ){ if( typeof addItem=== "function" ){ addItem( item, 1 ); } } advanceStory(); } //================================================ // ADVANCE STORY //================================================ function advanceStory(){ const current= StorySystem.currentChapter; const chapter= getStoryChapter( current ); if(!chapter) return; const completed= chapter.quests.every( quest=> quest.completed ); if(!completed) return; chapter.completed=true; const next= getStoryChapter( current+1 ); if(next){ next.unlocked=true; StorySystem.currentChapter++; } StorySystem.storyProgress= Math.min( 100, ( StorySystem.currentChapter- 1 )/ StorySystem.chapters.length* 100 ); } //================================================ // STORY FLAG //================================================ function setStoryFlag( name, value=true ){ StorySystem.flags[name]= value; } //================================================ // STORY FLAG CHECK //================================================ function getStoryFlag( name ){ return !!StorySystem.flags[name]; } //================================================ // DIALOGUE //================================================ class StoryDialogue{ constructor( speaker, text ){ this.speaker=speaker; this.text=text; } } //================================================ // DIALOGUE DATA //================================================ const StoryDialogues={ story_001:[ new StoryDialogue( "Elder", "The wind has chosen you." ), new StoryDialogue( "Hero", "Why me?" ), new StoryDialogue( "Elder", "Because the ancient crystal answered your call." ) ], story_003:[ new StoryDialogue( "Forest Spirit", "The crystal fragment lies beyond the ruins." ), new StoryDialogue( "Hero", "Then I will retrieve it." ), new StoryDialogue( "Forest Spirit", "Beware the guardian." ) ], story_017:[ new StoryDialogue( "Dark Lord", "Your journey ends here." ), new StoryDialogue( "Hero", "Wind Land will never fall." ), new StoryDialogue( "Dark Lord", "Then prove your worth." ) ] }; //================================================ // OPEN DIALOGUE //================================================ function openStoryDialogue( questId ){ const dialogue= StoryDialogues[ questId ]; if(!dialogue) return false; StorySystem.currentDialogue= dialogue; StorySystem.dialogueIndex=0; StorySystem.dialogueOpen=true; return true; } //================================================ // NEXT DIALOGUE //================================================ function nextStoryDialogue(){ if( !StorySystem.dialogueOpen ) return; const dialogue= StorySystem.currentDialogue; if(!dialogue) return; StorySystem.dialogueIndex++; if( StorySystem.dialogueIndex>= dialogue.length ){ StorySystem.dialogueOpen=false; StorySystem.dialogueIndex=0; } } //================================================ // DRAW DIALOGUE //================================================ function drawStoryDialogue(){ if( !StorySystem.dialogueOpen|| !StorySystem.currentDialogue ) return; if( typeof ctx==="undefined" ) return; const line= StorySystem.currentDialogue[ StorySystem.dialogueIndex ]; if(!line) return; ctx.save(); ctx.fillStyle= "rgba(5,8,18,.95)"; ctx.fillRect( 40, canvas.height-190, canvas.width-80, 140 ); ctx.strokeStyle= "#D8B45A"; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.strokeRect( 40, canvas.height-190, canvas.width-80, 140 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#FFD66B"; ctx.font= "bold 20px Arial"; ctx.fillText( line.speaker, 65, canvas.height-150 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#FFFFFF"; ctx.font= "18px Arial"; ctx.fillText( line.text, 65, canvas.height-110 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#999999"; ctx.font= "13px Arial"; ctx.fillText( "SPACE / CLICK", canvas.width-170, canvas.height-70 ); ctx.restore(); } //================================================ // STORY PANEL //================================================ function drawStoryPanel( x, y ){ if( typeof ctx==="undefined" ) return; const chapter= getStoryChapter( StorySystem.currentChapter ); if(!chapter) return; ctx.save(); ctx.fillStyle= "rgba(8,12,24,.97)"; ctx.fillRect( x, y, 540, 560 ); ctx.strokeStyle= "#D8B45A"; ctx.strokeRect( x, y, 540, 560 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#FFD66B"; ctx.font= "bold 25px Arial"; ctx.fillText( "STORY CAMPAIGN", x+20, y+38 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#FFFFFF"; ctx.font= "18px Arial"; ctx.fillText( "Chapter "+ chapter.id+ ": "+ chapter.title, x+20, y+75 ); ctx.font= "14px Arial"; ctx.fillStyle= "#BBBBBB"; ctx.fillText( chapter.description, x+20, y+102 ); let yy=y+145; for( const quest of chapter.quests ){ ctx.fillStyle= quest.completed? "#55DD77": quest.started? "#FFD66B": "#FFFFFF"; ctx.font= "bold 16px Arial"; ctx.fillText( quest.title, x+25, yy ); yy+=24; ctx.fillStyle= "#AAAAAA"; ctx.font= "13px Arial"; ctx.fillText( quest.description, x+40, yy ); yy+=24; for( const objective of quest.objectives ){ ctx.fillStyle= objective.completed? "#55DD77": "#CCCCCC"; ctx.fillText( "- "+ objective.target+ ": "+ objective.progress+ "/"+ objective.amount, x+55, yy ); yy+=20; } yy+=15; if( yy> y+530 ) break; } ctx.fillStyle= "#88CCFF"; ctx.fillText( "Story Progress: "+ StorySystem.storyProgress .toFixed(1)+ "%", x+20, y+540 ); ctx.restore(); } //================================================ // STORY INPUT //================================================ function handleStoryKey( key ){ if( StorySystem.dialogueOpen&& ( key===" "|| key==="Enter" ) ){ nextStoryDialogue(); return true; } return false; } //================================================ // STORY SAVE //================================================ function exportStoryData(){ const chapters={}; for( const chapter of StorySystem.chapters ){ chapters[ chapter.id ]={ unlocked: chapter.unlocked, completed: chapter.completed, quests: chapter.quests.map( quest=>({ id:quest.id, started:quest.started, completed:quest.completed, objectives: quest.objectives.map( objective=>({ id: objective.id, progress: objective.progress, completed: objective.completed }) ) }) ) }; } return{ currentChapter: StorySystem.currentChapter, currentQuest: StorySystem.currentQuest, storyProgress: StorySystem.storyProgress, flags: StorySystem.flags, chapters:chapters, rewards: [ ... StorySystem.rewardsClaimed ] }; } //================================================ // STORY LOAD //================================================ function importStoryData( data ){ if(!data) return; StorySystem.currentChapter= data.currentChapter|| 1; StorySystem.currentQuest= data.currentQuest|| null; StorySystem.storyProgress= data.storyProgress|| 0; StorySystem.flags= data.flags|| {}; StorySystem.rewardsClaimed= new Set( data.rewards|| [] ); if(data.chapters){ for( const id in data.chapters ){ const chapter= getStoryChapter( Number(id) ); if(!chapter) continue; const saved= data.chapters[id]; chapter.unlocked= !!saved.unlocked; chapter.completed= !!saved.completed; for( const savedQuest of saved.quests|| [] ){ const quest= chapter.quests.find( q=> q.id=== savedQuest.id ); if(!quest) continue; quest.started= !!savedQuest.started; quest.completed= !!savedQuest.completed; for( const savedObjective of savedQuest.objectives|| [] ){ const objective= quest.objectives.find( o=> o.id=== savedObjective.id ); if(!objective) continue; objective.progress= savedObjective.progress|| 0; objective.completed= !!savedObjective.completed; } } } } } //================================================ // INITIALIZE STORY //================================================ function initStorySystem(){ if( !StorySystem.chapters.length ) return; StorySystem.currentChapter= Math.max( 1, Math.min( StorySystem.currentChapter, StorySystem.chapters.length ) ); } //================================================ // END STORY CAMPAIGN SYSTEM //================================================ //================================================ // TITLE & REPUTATION SYSTEM V1 //================================================ const TitleSystem={ titles:new Map(), unlocked:new Set(), equipped:null, reputation:new Map(), fame:0, honor:0, infamy:0, titleExp:0, rank:"Unknown", history:[], activeBonuses:{} }; //================================================ // TITLE CLASS //================================================ class Title{ constructor( id, name, rarity ){ this.id=id; this.name=name; this.rarity=rarity; this.description=""; this.requirements={}; this.stats={}; this.effects=[]; this.hidden=false; this.unlocked=false; this.progress={}; } } //================================================ // REPUTATION FACTION //================================================ class ReputationFaction{ constructor( id, name ){ this.id=id; this.name=name; this.value=0; this.min=-10000; this.max=10000; this.rank="Neutral"; this.history=[]; this.bonuses={}; } } //================================================ // REGISTER TITLE //================================================ function registerTitle( id, name, rarity ){ const title= new Title( id, name, rarity ); TitleSystem.titles.set( id, title ); return title; } //================================================ // REGISTER FACTION //================================================ function registerFaction( id, name ){ const faction= new ReputationFaction( id, name ); titleNovice.description= "A new adventurer beginning the journey."; titleNovice.requirements={ level:5 }; titleNovice.stats={ hp:100, attack:5 }; const titleExplorer= registerTitle( "explorer", "World Explorer", "Rare" ); titleExplorer.description= "Explorer of dangerous lands."; titleExplorer.requirements={ maps:10, level:15 }; titleExplorer.stats={ hp:300, attack:15, moveSpeed:5 }; const titleMonsterHunter= registerTitle( "monster_hunter", "Monster Hunter", "Epic" ); titleMonsterHunter.description= "A legendary hunter of monsters."; titleMonsterHunter.requirements={ monsterKills:500, level:30 }; titleMonsterHunter.stats={ attack:50, crit:5 }; const titleDragonSlayer= registerTitle( "dragon_slayer", "Dragon Slayer", "Legendary" ); titleDragonSlayer.description= "Defeated an ancient dragon."; titleDragonSlayer.requirements={ dragonKills:1, level:50 }; titleDragonSlayer.stats={ attack:120, hp:1500, crit:10 }; const titleWindHero= registerTitle( "hero_of_wind", "Hero of Wind Land", "Mythic" ); titleWindHero.description= "The legendary hero chosen by the Wind."; titleWindHero.requirements={ level:100, storyChapter:12, reputation:5000 }; titleWindHero.stats={ attack:250, hp:5000, crit:15, moveSpeed:15 }; titleWindHero.effects.push( "Wind Blessing" ); //================================================ // FACTIONS //================================================ const kingdomFaction= registerFaction( "wind_kingdom", "Wind Kingdom" ); kingdomFaction.bonuses={ shopDiscount:0.10, questReward:1.10 }; const merchantFaction= registerFaction( "merchant_guild", "Merchant Guild" ); merchantFaction.bonuses={ shopDiscount:0.15, sellPrice:1.15 }; const guardianFaction= registerFaction( "wind_guardians", "Wind Guardians" ); guardianFaction.bonuses={ defense:10, damageReduction:0.05 }; const hunterFaction= registerFaction( "monster_hunters", "Monster Hunters" ); hunterFaction.bonuses={ monsterDamage:0.10, monsterExp:1.15 }; const shadowFaction= registerFaction( "shadow_clan", "Shadow Clan" ); shadowFaction.bonuses={ crit:5, dodge:5, stealth:1 }; //================================================ // REPUTATION RANK //================================================ function calculateReputationRank( value ){ if(value>=9000) return "Exalted"; if(value>=6000) return "Revered"; if(value>=3000) return "Honored"; if(value>=1000) return "Friendly"; if(value>=0) return "Neutral"; if(value>=-1000) return "Unfriendly"; if(value>=-3000) return "Hostile"; if(value>=-6000) return "Hated"; return "Enemy"; } //================================================ // ADD REPUTATION //================================================ function addReputation( factionId, amount, reason="" ){ const faction= TitleSystem.reputation.get( factionId ); if(!faction) return; faction.value+=amount; faction.value= Math.max( faction.min, Math.min( faction.max, faction.value ) ); faction.rank= calculateReputationRank( faction.value ); faction.history.push({ amount:amount, reason:reason, time:Date.now() }); if( faction.history.length>100 ){ faction.history.shift(); } TitleSystem.titleExp+= Math.max( 0, amount ); checkAllTitles(); } //================================================ // GET REPUTATION //================================================ function getReputation( factionId ){ const faction= TitleSystem.reputation.get( factionId ); if(!faction) return 0; return faction.value; } //================================================ // TITLE REQUIREMENT CHECK //================================================ function checkTitleRequirement( title ){ if(!title) return false; const req= title.requirements|| {}; if( req.level&& ( !Player|| Player.level1 ){ value*= multiplier; }else{ additive+= multiplier; } } return value+ additive; } //================================================ // FAME //================================================ function addFame( amount ){ TitleSystem.fame+= Math.max( 0, amount ); updateFameRank(); } //================================================ // HONOR //================================================ function addHonor( amount ){ TitleSystem.honor+= amount; TitleSystem.honor= Math.max( 0, TitleSystem.honor ); } //================================================ // INFAMY //================================================ function addInfamy( amount ){ TitleSystem.infamy+= Math.max( 0, amount ); } //================================================ // FAME RANK //================================================ function updateFameRank(){ const fame= TitleSystem.fame; if(fame>=100000) TitleSystem.rank= "Legend"; else if(fame>=50000) TitleSystem.rank= "Famous"; else if(fame>=20000) TitleSystem.rank= "Renowned"; else if(fame>=5000) TitleSystem.rank= "Known"; else TitleSystem.rank= "Unknown"; } //================================================ // TITLE EXP //================================================ function addTitleExp( amount ){ TitleSystem.titleExp+= Math.max( 0, amount ); if( TitleSystem.titleExp>=1000 ){ const levels= Math.floor( TitleSystem.titleExp/ 1000 ); TitleSystem.titleExp%=1000; addFame( levels* 100 ); } } //================================================ // TITLE HUD //================================================ function drawTitleHUD(){ if( typeof ctx==="undefined" ) return; ctx.save(); ctx.fillStyle= "rgba(10,10,20,.85)"; ctx.fillRect( canvas.width- 280, 20, 260, 100 ); ctx.strokeStyle= "#D8B45A"; ctx.strokeRect( canvas.width- 280, 20, 260, 100 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#FFD66B"; ctx.font= "bold 16px Arial"; ctx.fillText( TitleSystem.equipped? TitleSystem.equipped.name: "No Title", canvas.width- 260, 45 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#FFFFFF"; ctx.font= "13px Arial"; ctx.fillText( "Fame: "+ TitleSystem.fame, canvas.width- 260, 68 ); ctx.fillText( "Honor: "+ TitleSystem.honor, canvas.width- 260, 88 ); ctx.fillText( "Rank: "+ TitleSystem.rank, canvas.width- 260, 108 ); ctx.restore(); } //================================================ // TITLE SAVE //================================================ function exportTitleData(){ const factions={}; for( const [ id, faction ] of TitleSystem.reputation ){ factions[id]={ value:faction.value, rank:faction.rank }; } return{ unlocked: [ ... TitleSystem.unlocked ], equipped: TitleSystem.equipped? TitleSystem.equipped.id: null, reputation:factions, fame:TitleSystem.fame, honor:TitleSystem.honor, infamy:TitleSystem.infamy, titleExp:TitleSystem.titleExp, rank:TitleSystem.rank }; } //================================================ // TITLE LOAD //================================================ function importTitleData( data ){ if(!data) return; TitleSystem.unlocked= new Set( data.unlocked|| [] ); for( const id in data.reputation|| {} ){ const faction= TitleSystem.reputation.get( id ); if(!faction) continue; faction.value= data.reputation[id].value|| 0; faction.rank= data.reputation[id].rank|| calculateReputationRank( faction.value ); } TitleSystem.fame= data.fame|| 0; TitleSystem.honor= data.honor|| 0; TitleSystem.infamy= data.infamy|| 0; TitleSystem.titleExp= data.titleExp|| 0; TitleSystem.rank= data.rank|| "Unknown"; for( const title of TitleSystem.titles.values() ){ title.unlocked= TitleSystem.unlocked.has( title.id ); } if( data.equipped ){ equipTitle( data.equipped ); } } //================================================ // END TITLE & REPUTATION SYSTEM V1 //================================================ //================================================ // ARENA & PVP RANKING SYSTEM V1 //================================================ const ArenaSystem={ matches:new Map(), activeMatch:null, season:1, seasonTime:0, seasonDuration:2592000, rating:1000, rankPoints:0, wins:0, losses:0, draws:0, winStreak:0, bestStreak:0, rank:"Bronze", tier:3, opponents:[], leaderboard:[], history:[], rewardsClaimed:false, matchmaking:false, queue:[], cooldown:0 }; //================================================ // ARENA RANKS //================================================ const ArenaRanks=[ { id:"bronze", name:"Bronze", min:0, max:1199, color:"#CD7F32" }, { id:"silver", name:"Silver", min:1200, max:1499, color:"#C0C0C0" }, { id:"gold", name:"Gold", min:1500, max:1799, color:"#FFD700" }, { id:"platinum", name:"Platinum", min:1800, max:2099, color:"#66D9EF" }, { id:"diamond", name:"Diamond", min:2100, max:2399, color:"#8F7CFF" }, { id:"master", name:"Master", min:2400, max:2699, color:"#FF55DD" }, { id:"grandmaster", name:"Grandmaster", min:2700, max:2999, color:"#FF6633" }, { id:"legend", name:"Legend", min:3000, max:999999, color:"#FFD66B" } ]; //================================================ // ARENA OPPONENT //================================================ class ArenaOpponent{ constructor( id, name, level ){ this.id=id; this.name=name; this.level=level; this.rating=1000; this.hp=1000; this.maxHp=1000; this.attack=100; this.defense=50; this.crit=5; this.speed=100; this.classId="warrior"; this.ai="balanced"; this.bot=true; } } //================================================ // ARENA MATCH //================================================ class ArenaMatch{ constructor( id, opponent ){ this.id=id; this.opponent=opponent; this.duration=180; this.remaining=180; this.playerHp= Player.maxHp; this.opponentHp= opponent.maxHp; this.playerScore=0; this.opponentScore=0; this.state="waiting"; this.startedAt=0; this.endedAt=0; this.result=null; this.damageDealt=0; this.damageTaken=0; this.combo=0; this.maxCombo=0; } } //================================================ // CREATE OPPONENT //================================================ function createArenaOpponent(){ const level= Math.max( 1, Player.level+ Math.floor( Math.random()*7 )- 3 ); const opponent= new ArenaOpponent( "arena_bot_"+ Date.now(), [ "Storm Knight", "Shadow Warrior", "Wind Ranger", "Fire Mage", "Holy Guardian", "Dark Assassin", "Crystal Berserker" ][ Math.floor( Math.random()*7 ) ], level ); const ratio= level/ Math.max( 1, Player.level ); opponent.rating= Math.max( 800, Math.floor( ArenaSystem.rating+ ( Math.random()*400- 200 ) ) ); opponent.maxHp= Math.floor( 1200* ratio ); opponent.hp= opponent.maxHp; opponent.attack= Math.floor( 100* ratio ); opponent.defense= Math.floor( 50* ratio ); opponent.crit= Math.floor( 5+ Math.random()*10 ); return opponent; } //================================================ // FIND MATCH //================================================ function findArenaMatch(){ if( ArenaSystem.cooldown>0|| ArenaSystem.activeMatch ){ return null; ArenaSystem.cooldown= Math.max( 0, ArenaSystem.cooldown ); } ArenaSystem.seasonTime+=dt; if( ArenaSystem.seasonTime>= ArenaSystem.seasonDuration ){ ArenaSystem.seasonTime=0; endArenaSeason(); } const match= ArenaSystem.activeMatch; const treasureHunt= registerWorldEvent( "treasure_hunt", WorldEventTypes.TREASURE_HUNT, "Lost Treasure Hunt", "Ancient treasure has been discovered." ); treasureHunt.zone= "forgotten_ruins"; treasureHunt.duration=450; treasureHunt.targetProgress=10; treasureHunt.difficulty=3; treasureHunt.rewards={ gold:15000, exp:25000, items:[ "ancient_coin", "mysterious_chest" ], reputation:200, fame:100, honor:50 }; const villageDefense= registerWorldEvent( "village_defense", WorldEventTypes.VILLAGE_ATTACK, "Village Under Attack", "Monsters are attacking a nearby village." ); villageDefense.zone= "wind_village"; villageDefense.duration=420; villageDefense.targetProgress=100; villageDefense.difficulty=4; villageDefense.rewards={ gold:12000, exp:30000, items:["village_medal"], reputation:300, fame:150, honor:100 }; const meteorShower= registerWorldEvent( "meteor_shower", WorldEventTypes.METEOR_SHOWER, "Meteor Shower", "Rare celestial stones are falling across the world." ); meteorShower.zone= "all"; meteorShower.duration=300; meteorShower.targetProgress=50; meteorShower.difficulty=5; meteorShower.rewards={ gold:20000, exp:20000, items:[ "meteor_fragment", "star_crystal" ], reputation:250, fame:200, honor:100 }; const demonGate= registerWorldEvent( "demon_gate", WorldEventTypes.DEMON_GATE, "Demon Gate", "A forbidden portal to the demon realm has opened." ); demonGate.zone= "dark_forest"; demonGate.duration=900; demonGate.targetProgress=300; demonGate.difficulty=9; demonGate.rewards={ gold:75000, exp:150000, items:[ "demon_core", "dark_relic", "demon_chest" ], reputation:1500, fame:1500, honor:750 }; //================================================ // CREATE EVENT INSTANCE //================================================ function createWorldEventInstance( templateId ){ const template= WorldEventSystem.events.get( templateId ); if(!template) return null; const id= templateId+ "_" + (++WorldEventSystem.eventIdCounter)+ "_" + Date.now(); const event= new WorldEvent( id, template.type, template.name ); event.description= template.description; event.zone= template.zone; event.duration= template.duration; event.timeRemaining= template.duration; event.minLevel= template.minLevel; event.maxLevel= template.maxLevel; event.requiredPlayers= template.requiredPlayers; event.maxPlayers= template.maxPlayers; event.difficulty= template.difficulty; event.targetProgress= template.targetProgress; event.rewards= JSON.parse( JSON.stringify( template.rewards ) ); event.bossHp= template.bossHp; event.maxBossHp= template.maxBossHp; event.modifiers= JSON.parse( JSON.stringify( template.modifiers ) ); return event; } //================================================ // SPAWN RANDOM EVENT //================================================ function spawnRandomWorldEvent(){ const templates= Array.from( WorldEventSystem.events.values() ); if( templates.length===0 ) return null; const available= templates.filter( event=>{ return ( !isWorldEventBlocked( event ) ); } ); if( available.length===0 ) return null; const template= available[ Math.floor( Math.random()* available.length ) ]; const event= createWorldEventInstance( template.id ); if(!event) return null; WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.set( event.id, event ); event.state= WorldEventState.ACTIVE; event.createdAt= Date.now(); return event; } //================================================ // EVENT BLOCK //================================================ function isWorldEventBlocked( event ){ if(!event) return true; if( event.minLevel> ( typeof Player!=="undefined"? Player.level: 1 ) ) return true; return false; } //================================================ // JOIN EVENT //================================================ function joinWorldEvent( eventId ){ const event= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId ); if(!event) return false; if( event.state!== WorldEventState.ACTIVE ) return false; if( event.participants.includes( "player" ) ) return true; if( event.participants.length>= event.maxPlayers ) return false; event.participants.push( "player" ); return true; } //================================================ // LEAVE EVENT //================================================ function leaveWorldEvent( eventId ){ const event= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId ); if(!event) return false; event.participants= event.participants.filter( id=> id!=="player" ); return true; } //================================================ // EVENT PROGRESS //================================================ function addWorldEventProgress( eventId, amount, source ){ const event= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId ); if(!event) return false; if( event.state!== WorldEventState.ACTIVE ) return false; const value= Math.max( 0, amount ); event.progress+= value; if( event.progress>= event.targetProgress ){ event.progress= event.targetProgress; completeWorldEvent( eventId ); } return true; } //================================================ // EVENT KILL //================================================ function registerWorldEventKill( eventId ){ const event= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId ); if(!event) return false; event.kills++; let progress=1; if( event.difficulty>=8 ){ progress=2; } addWorldEventProgress( eventId, progress, "kill" ); return true; } //================================================ // BOSS DAMAGE //================================================ function damageWorldEventBoss( eventId, damage ){ const event= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId ); if(!event) return 0; if( event.bossHp<=0 ) return 0; const amount= Math.max( 1, Math.floor( damage ) ); event.bossHp-= amount; event.progress= Math.min( event.targetProgress, ( 1- Math.max( 0, event.bossHp )/ event.maxBossHp )* event.targetProgress ); if( event.bossHp<=0 ){ event.bossHp=0; event.progress= event.targetProgress; completeWorldEvent( eventId ); } return amount; } //================================================ // UPDATE WORLD EVENTS //================================================ function updateWorldEvents( dt ){ WorldEventSystem.timer+=dt; WorldEventSystem.nextEventTimer-=dt; if( WorldEventSystem.nextEventTimer<=0 ){ spawnRandomWorldEvent(); WorldEventSystem.nextEventTimer= WorldEventSystem.eventInterval+ Math.random()*120; } for( const [ id, event ] of WorldEventSystem.activeEvents ){ if( event.state!== WorldEventState.ACTIVE ) continue; event.timeRemaining-=dt; if( event.timeRemaining<=0 ){ event.timeRemaining=0; failWorldEvent( id ); } updateWorldEventModifiers( event, dt ); } calculateWorldState(); } //================================================ // EVENT MODIFIERS //================================================ function updateWorldEventModifiers( event, dt ){ if(!event) return; switch( event.type ){ case WorldEventTypes.MONSTER_INVASION: WorldEventSystem.monsterModifier= Math.max( WorldEventSystem.monsterModifier, 1.15 ); break; case WorldEventTypes.STORM: WorldEventSystem.weatherModifier= 0.75; break; case WorldEventTypes.FESTIVAL: WorldEventSystem.rewardMultiplier= 1.25; break; case WorldEventTypes.DEMON_GATE: WorldEventSystem.worldThreat= Math.min( 100, WorldEventSystem.worldThreat+ dt* 0.01 ); break; } } //================================================ // COMPLETE //================================================ function completeWorldEvent( eventId ){ const event= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId ); if(!event) return false; if( event.state!== WorldEventState.ACTIVE ) return false; event.state= WorldEventState.COMPLETED; event.completedAt= Date.now(); WorldEventSystem.completed.add( eventId ); grantWorldEventRewards( event ); WorldEventSystem.history.unshift({ id:event.id, name:event.name, type:event.type, result:"completed", progress:event.progress, time:Date.now() }); WorldEventSystem.history= WorldEventSystem.history.slice( 0, 200 ); WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.delete( eventId ); WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity= Math.min( 100, WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity+ event.difficulty* 0.5 ); WorldEventSystem.worldThreat= Math.max( 0, WorldEventSystem.worldThreat- event.difficulty ); return true; } //================================================ // FAIL //================================================ function failWorldEvent( eventId ){ const event= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId ); if(!event) return false; if( event.state!== WorldEventState.ACTIVE ) return false; event.state= WorldEventState.FAILED; event.expiredAt= Date.now(); WorldEventSystem.failed.add( eventId ); WorldEventSystem.history.unshift({ id:event.id, name:event.name, type:event.type, result:"failed", progress:event.progress, time:Date.now() }); WorldEventSystem.history= WorldEventSystem.history.slice( 0, 200 ); WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.delete( eventId ); WorldEventSystem.worldThreat= Math.min( 100, WorldEventSystem.worldThreat+ event.difficulty* 1.5 ); WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity= Math.max( 0, WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity- event.difficulty ); return true; } //================================================ // REWARDS //================================================ function grantWorldEventRewards( event ){ if(!event) return; const multiplier= WorldEventSystem.rewardMultiplier* WorldEventSystem.globalMultiplier; const gold= Math.floor( event.rewards.gold* multiplier ); const exp= Math.floor( event.rewards.exp* multiplier ); if( typeof Player!=="undefined" ){ if( Player.gold!==undefined ){ Player.gold+=gold; } if( typeof Player.addExp==="function" ){ Player.addExp( exp ); } } if( typeof addFame==="function" ){ addFame( Math.floor( event.rewards.fame* multiplier ) ); } if( typeof addHonor==="function" ){ addHonor( Math.floor( event.rewards.honor* multiplier ) ); } if( event.rewards.reputation&& typeof addReputation==="function" ){ addReputation( "wind_guard", Math.floor( event.rewards.reputation* multiplier ), event.name ); } for( const itemId of event.rewards.items ){ giveWorldEventItem( itemId ); } WorldEventSystem.globalMultiplier= 1; } //================================================ // ITEM REWARD //================================================ function giveWorldEventItem( itemId ){ if( typeof InventorySystem!=="undefined" ){ if( typeof InventorySystem.addItem==="function" ){ InventorySystem.addItem( itemId, 1 ); return; } } if( typeof addItem==="function" ){ addItem( itemId, 1 ); } } //================================================ // WORLD STATE //================================================ function calculateWorldState(){ const active= WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.size; WorldEventSystem.worldThreat= Math.max( 0, Math.min( 100, WorldEventSystem.worldThreat ) ); WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity= Math.max( 0, Math.min( 100, WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity ) ); WorldEventSystem.monsterModifier= 1+ WorldEventSystem.worldThreat/ 100* 0.5; WorldEventSystem.rewardMultiplier= 1+ WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity/ 100* 0.25; WorldEventSystem.globalMultiplier= 1+ active* 0.05; } //================================================ // GET ACTIVE EVENTS //================================================ function getActiveWorldEvents(){ return Array.from( WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.values() ); } //================================================ // GET EVENT //================================================ function getWorldEvent( eventId ){ return WorldEventSystem.activeEvents.get( eventId )|| null; } //================================================ // WORLD EVENT BOSS //================================================ function getWorldEventBossHP( eventId ){ const event= getWorldEvent( eventId ); if(!event) return null; return{ hp:event.bossHp, maxHp:event.maxBossHp, percent: event.maxBossHp>0? event.bossHp/ event.maxBossHp* 100: 0 }; } //================================================ // EVENT DIFFICULTY //================================================ function calculateWorldEventDifficulty( event ){ if(!event) return 1; const level= typeof Player!=="undefined"? Player.level: 1; return Math.max( 1, Math.floor( event.difficulty+ level* 0.02 ) ); } //================================================ // PLAYER EVENT POWER //================================================ function getWorldEventPower(){ if( typeof Player==="undefined" ) return 0; return Math.floor( Player.attack* 2+ Player.defense* 1.5+ Player.maxHp* 0.05 ); } //================================================ // EVENT HUD //================================================ function drawWorldEventHUD(){ if( typeof ctx==="undefined" ) return; const events= getActiveWorldEvents(); if( events.length===0 ) return; const width=320; const height= 80+ events.length* 58; ctx.save(); ctx.fillStyle= "rgba(8,12,22,.90)"; ctx.fillRect( 20, 210, width, height ); ctx.strokeStyle= "#D8B45A"; ctx.strokeRect( 20, 210, width, height ); ctx.fillStyle= "#FFD66B"; ctx.font= "bold 16px Arial"; ctx.fillText( "WORLD EVENTS", 38, 237 ); let y=263; for( const event of events ){ ctx.fillStyle= "#FFFFFF"; ctx.font= "bold 13px Arial"; ctx.fillText( event.name, 38, y ); ctx.font= "11px Arial"; ctx.fillStyle= "#BBBBBB"; ctx.fillText( event.zone+ " | "+ Math.ceil( event.timeRemaining )+ "s", 38, y+16 ); const progress= event.targetProgress>0? event.progress/ event.targetProgress: 0; ctx.fillStyle= "#222"; ctx.fillRect( 38, y+24, 270, 8 ); ctx.fillStyle= "#55DD77"; ctx.fillRect( 38, y+24, 270* Math.max( 0, Math.min( 1, progress ) ), 8 ); y+=58; } ctx.restore(); } //================================================ // WORLD EVENT NOTIFICATION //================================================ function notifyWorldEvent( event ){ if(!event) return; if( typeof showNotification==="function" ){ showNotification( "WORLD EVENT: "+ event.name ); } } //================================================ // EVENT TELEPORT //================================================ function teleportToWorldEvent( eventId ){ const event= getWorldEvent( eventId ); if(!event) return false; if( typeof teleportToZone==="function" ){ return teleportToZone( event.zone ); } if( typeof changeMap==="function" ){ return changeMap( event.zone ); } return false; } //================================================ // SAVE //================================================ function exportWorldEventData(){ return{ completed: Array.from( WorldEventSystem.completed ), failed: Array.from( WorldEventSystem.failed ), history: WorldEventSystem.history.slice( 0, 200 ), worldThreat: WorldEventSystem.worldThreat, worldProsperity: WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity, nextEventTimer: WorldEventSystem.nextEventTimer, eventIdCounter: WorldEventSystem.eventIdCounter }; } //================================================ // LOAD //================================================ function importWorldEventData( data ){ if(!data) return; WorldEventSystem.completed= new Set( data.completed|| [] ); WorldEventSystem.failed= new Set( data.failed|| [] ); WorldEventSystem.history= data.history|| []; WorldEventSystem.worldThreat= data.worldThreat|| 0; WorldEventSystem.worldProsperity= data.worldProsperity|| 0; WorldEventSystem.nextEventTimer= data.nextEventTimer|| 60; WorldEventSystem.eventIdCounter= data.eventIdCounter|| 0; calculateWorldState(); } //================================================ // INITIALIZE //================================================ calculateWorldState(); //================================================ // END DYNAMIC WORLD EVENTS SYSTEM V1 //================================================
